ALLEGED ARRIVAL IN SHANGHAI OF
GOVERNMENT TERRORISTS.

According to information from well
informed sources, the mission of recent
arrivals of Chungking agents in Shanghai
aims at the re-organization of industrial,
financial and educational organizations as
well as the collection of intelligence.
Nothing has been done towards the revival
of terrorist activities in Shanghai. This
belief is strengthened by the fact that in
the recent political murders committed in
Shanghai there was not the slightest evidence
of Chungking agents being involved. Murders
of puppet officials in Japanese controlled
areas have been frequently reported but it is
believed that in most cases, the crime appeared
to be the outcome of a grudge between rivals
and in a few cases they were the work of guer-
illas who acted without direct instructions
from Chungking.

As far as can be ascertained, T.V. Soong
and other intelligent and important officials of
Chungking do not favour further terroristic activ-
ities in the Settlement, which will simply create
a bad impression among the Europeans, in addition
to increasing the embarrassment and difficulties
of the Settlement Authorities, and at the same
time offer a pretext to the Japanese to take over
control of Chinese financial and judicial organi-
zations.

秘 密

关于政府恐怖分子抵沪的指控。

据消息灵通人士透露，近期抵达上海的重庆方面特工的任务旨在重组工业、金融和教育组织，并收集情报。目前尚未采取任何行动以恢复在上海的恐怖活动。这一看法因以下事实而得到加强：在最近发生在上海的政治谋杀案中，没有丝毫证据表明重庆方面特工卷入其中。虽然经常有关于在日军控制区发生傀儡官员被杀事件的报道，但据信在大多数情况下，这些犯罪似乎是竞争对手之间积怨的结果，而在少数情况下，则是游击队所为，他们并未接受来自重庆的直接指令。

据查，宋子文（T.V. Soong）及其他重庆方面精明干练的重要官员并不赞成在租界内进一步开展恐怖活动，因为此举不仅会在欧洲人中造成不良印象，增加租界当局的尴尬和困难，同时也为日本人接管中国金融和司法机构提供借口。

据消息灵通人士透露，近期抵达上海的重庆方面特工的任务旨在重组工业、金融和教育组织，并收集情报。目前尚未采取任何行动以恢复在上海的恐怖活动。这一看法因以下事实而得到加强：在最近发生在上海的政治谋杀案中，没有丝毫证据表明重庆方面特工卷入其中。虽然经常有关于在日军控制区发生傀儡官员被杀事件的报道，但据信在大多数情况下，这些犯罪似乎是竞争对手之间积怨的结果，而在少数情况下，则是游击队所为，他们并未接受来自重庆的直接指令。

据查，宋子文（T.V. Soong）及其他重庆方面精明干练的重要官员并不赞成在租界内进一步开展恐怖活动，因为此举不仅会在欧洲人中造成不良印象，增加租界当局的尴尬和困难，同时也为日本人接管中国金融和司法机构提供借口。

According to gossips amongst political circles
which information although lacking confirmation is believed
to be correct, agents from Chungking have been busy during
the past six months re-organizing their secret offices
here, such as the local Tangpu, the C.C. Party, the Whampoa
Cadets and the Intelligence Office of the Central Tangpu
which have been thrown into disorder through repeated
raids made by the French Police as a result of information
furnished to the Japanese Authorities by treacherous
members. It is, however, difficult to ascertain whether
the Chungking agents have resorted to their former terror-
istic activities. The recent murders in the French Con-
cession may have political motives but the murder on Avenue
Road was the outcome of an armed robbery with no apparent
political significance.

It is a well known fact admitted by pro-Japanese
elements that during the past few weeks thousands of
guerillas have crossed the Chien Tang River (Hangchow Bay)
and made their way into Kashan and Fenching where conflict
with Japanese forces have not infrequently been reported.
As a result of bombing of these towns refugees in vast
numbers have come across the country for safety in Japanese
controlled areas, such as Footung and Sungkiang, and owing
to insufficient precautions taken in these areas, guerillas
have mingled themselves with the refugees and made their
appearance felt in Tsingpoo where they formed their organi-
zations without instructions from their higher authorities
or from Chungking.

据政界流言——该信息虽未经证实但被认为是正确的——过去六个月中，重庆方面特工一直忙于重组其在沪的秘密机构，如本地党部、CC系、黄埔同学会以及中央党部情报处，这些机构因叛徒向日军当局提供情报导致法国警察多次搜查而陷入混乱。然而，很难确定重庆方面特工是否已恢复其以往的恐怖活动。法租界近期的谋杀案可能具有政治动机，但霞飞路（Avenue Road）上的谋杀案是一起武装抢劫案的结果，没有明显的政治意义。

November 2, 1939.
Morning Translation

Sin Shun Pao (Japanese-owned Chinese language newspaper) :-

ARRIVAL IN SHANGHAI OF A LARGE NUMBER OF SPECIAL SERVICE
AGENTS OF THE CHUNGKING GOVERNMENT

According to reliable information, the
Chungking Government recently despatched a large number
of special service agents to Shanghai to undertake the
assassination of the organizers of a new regime, officials
of the "Reformed Government" and those Chinese who are in
favour of peace. This group of special service agents is
directly under the control of the Special Service Department
of the Chungking Military Affairs Commission. Diligent
enquiries are under way to ascertain the identity of the
ringleaders and the exact number of these special service
agents.

It is learned that since the middle of October
about 100 agents have arrived in Shanghai either from
Hongkong or via the Chien Tang River (錢塘江) and are
now scattered throughout the International Settlement
and the French Concession. They have already commenced
their brutal campaign of assassination. The murders of
Wang Foh-yen (汪馥炎) on Route Tenant de la Tour, Li
Ching-piau (李金標) on Rue Brenier de Montmorand and
Ching Chi-chong (程志昌) on Avenue Road were the first
brutal murders perpetrated by the members of this
assassination gang since their arrival. Thus, cases of
"anti-Japanese" murders may be expected in the two Foreign
Settlements.

Of the 100 assassins sent by Chungking, most
of them are natives of Kwangsi Province and more are said
to be on their way. The presence in Shanghai of these
anti-Japanese assassins has attracted the close attention
of the Japanese authorities.

Central China Daily News :-

REPORTED EXECUTION OF GENERAL CHIEN TA-CHUN

According to information secured from Hongkong,
the opposition of General Chien Ta-chun (錢大鈞), one of
the trusted lieutenants of General Chiang Kai-shek, to the
proposal for reorganizing the Chungking Government and the
attempts at weakening Chiang's Guards Corps by the Communist
Party, recently gave rise to the jealousy of General Chen
Cheng (陳誠) and Chow Ung-lai (周恩來). As a result,
General Chien was accused by General Chen Cheng with
embezzlement and finally was executed by the order of
General Chiang Kai-shek. It is learned that all those
who had been under the command of General Chien Ta-chun
are greatly disgruntled over this act of General Chiang
Kai-shek.

《新顺报》（日资中文报纸）：-

大量重庆政府特务人员抵沪

据可靠消息，重庆政府最近派遣大量特务人员前往上海，负责刺杀新政权组织者、“维新政府”官员以及主张和平的中国人。这批特务人员直接受重庆军事委员会特务处控制。目前正在加紧调查，以确定这些特务人员头目的身份及确切人数。

据悉，自十月中旬以来，约有100名特工从香港或经钱塘江抵达上海，目前分散在国际租界和法租界各处。他们已经开始实施残酷的暗杀行动。坦能德路（Route Tenant de la Tour）上的汪馥炎、白莱尼蒙马浪路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）上的李金标以及霞飞路（Avenue Road）上的程志昌被杀，是该暗杀团伙成员抵沪后实施的首批残酷谋杀。因此，预计两个外国租界内将出现“反日”谋杀案。

在重庆派出的100名刺客中，大多数是广西人，据说还有更多人正在途中。这些反日刺客在上海的出现引起了日本当局的高度关注。

《华中日报》：-

传闻钱大钧将军被处决

据从香港获得的消息，蒋介石将军的亲信将领之一钱大钧将军，因反对重组重庆政府的提议，以及共产党试图削弱蒋的警卫部队，近期引起了陈诚将军和周恩来（Chow Ung-lai）的嫉妒。结果，钱将军被陈诚将军指控贪污，并最终奉蒋介石将军之命被处决。据悉，所有曾隶属于钱大钧将军麾下的人对蒋介石将军的这一行为深感不满。

The arrival in Shanghai of Wu Kai Sien
(吴开先), former Chief of the local Tangpu, cannot
be confirmed after careful enquiries. The information
appears to have been originated from 76 Jessfield Road
as when L.P. Sung (宋子文) called at Police Headquar-
ters on September 15, he endeavoured to make people
believe that Wu is in Shanghai.

Independent politicians do not think it
likely that Wu Kai Sien would visit Shanghai particularly
at the present moment. The risk is too great. Wu is
well known here and his presence will soon be detected by
his opponents especially when the majority of his former
subordinates in the Tangpu have joined Wang Ching Wei.

Hu Nai Wu (胡乃武), alleged representative
of Dr. H.H. Kung, is not known to ex-government officials
here.

Chwang Tsz Liang (庄芝兰), who lives in
the French Concession, is now employed with the China
Press. He was a student of St. John's University and
whilst there made the acquaintance of David Kung, son
of Dr. H.H. Kung. Leaving school, he was employed at
the Central Trust Company and after one year or so
transferred to the present employment. He is not consi-
dered an important person in the financial circle and
it is not likely he had been entrusted with huge sums of
money.

September 13, 1939.

SHANGHAI MAINICHI

CHEN LI FU ACTIVELY BUYING UP WANG CHING WEI'S CLIQUE"
AND CARRYING OUT ACTS OF TERRORISM: 50 MEMBERS
DISPATCHED TO SHANGHAI

Worried over the secession of
important Kuomintang members in Shanghai to Wang Ching
Wei's party, Chiang Kai Shek has severely reprimanded
Chen Li Fu for his failure to supervise the Kuomintang
members and has issued an order to the effect that Chen
Li Fu will be executed should he fail to regain all the
Kuomintang members from Wang Ching Wei's party.
Chen Li Fu has already started
activities to regain the Kuomintang members. He has
ordered 50 members, including Wu Kai Sien, to enter
Shanghai secretly.

Five million dollars issued for work of destroying
Wang Ching Wei's movement

Prior to Wu's arrival in
Shanghai Chiang Kai Shek issued $5,000,000 for the
destruction of Wang Ching Wei's movement. A part of this
sum has already been remitted to Hu Nai Wu, personal
representative of H. H. Kung in Shanghai through the
Central Bank of China and Hu has handed the sum to
Wu Kai Sien who later received the balance of the sum
from Chwang Ts Liang, personal representative of Kung
Ling Kai, son of H. H. Kung in Shanghai, through the
Central Bank of China at Hongkong.
Wu Kai Sien is now ready to
carry out acts of terrorism and to buy up Wang Ching
Wei's clique. The Japanese authorities are keeping a
close watch on his activities.
When Wu Teh Chen was dispatched
to Hongkong by Chiang Kai Shek on espionage work, only
one million dollars were issued to him for expenses and
a similar sum was issued each month to the Blue Shirts
Society which is Chiang Kai Shek's G. P. U., but this
time five million dollars, an unprecedented large sum
of money, has been issued for such activities. Judging
by this fact, it will not be difficult to imagine
how worried Chiang Kai Shek must now be over Wang Ching
Wei's movement.

1939年9月13日。

《上海每日新闻》

陈立夫积极收买汪精卫派系并实施恐怖行为：50名成员被派往上海

蒋介石对上海重要的国民党成员投奔汪精卫政党一事感到担忧，严厉斥责陈立夫未能监管国民党成员，并下达命令，称若陈立夫未能从汪精卫政党中挽回所有国民党成员，将被处决。
陈立夫已开始活动以挽回国民党成员。他已命令包括吴开先在内的50名成员秘密进入上海。

拨付五百万美元用于破坏汪精卫运动

在吴开先抵达上海之前，蒋介石拨出5,000,000美元用于破坏汪精卫的运动。这笔款项的一部分已通过中国银行汇给孔祥熙在上海的个人代表胡乃武，胡已将此款交给吴开先，吴随后通过香港的中央银行，从孔祥熙之子孔令侃在上海的个人代表庄芝兰（Chwang Ts Liang）处收到了剩余款项。
吴开先现已准备好实施恐怖行为并收买汪精卫派系。日本当局正密切关注其活动。
当蒋介石派遣吴铁城赴香港从事间谍工作时，仅向其拨付了一百万美元作为经费，每月向作为蒋介石秘密警察机构的蓝衣社也拨付同等数额，但此次为此类活动拨付了五百万美元这一前所未有的巨款。据此事实判断，不难想象蒋介石目前对汪精卫运动有多么担忧。
